text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 86 单元

symphonic
音标：英 /sɪm'fɒnɪk/  美 /sɪm'fɑnɪk/
adj. 交响乐的, 和声的
短语：symphonic poem — 交响诗
例句：Of course, anyone knows that it is impossible to play a symphonic work with just three strings.
当然，每个人都知道，只用三根弦来演奏交响乐是不可能的。
例句：The orchestra had been planning a British symphonic celebration with Hickox for 2010, and a Britten celebration for the Olympic year, 2012.
乐团正与希考克斯一 起计划2010年的英国交响乐盛典，还有2012年奥运年的布里顿庆典。
例句：In fact, when the symphonic stars align, classical music concerts make for quite brilliant theatre.
事实上，当那些交响明星们整装登场之时，古典音乐会也是场绝伦的表演。

sad
音标：英 /sæd/  美 /sæd/
adj. 忧愁的, 悲哀的
短语：so sad — 如此悲伤；如此难过
短语：feel sad — 感到悲伤；心酸
短语：in sad earnest — [古语]十分严肃地，一本正经地
短语：sad face — 愁容
短语：if you are sad — 若你悲哀
例句：The relationship had been important to me and its loss left me feeling sad and empty.
这种关系对我一直都很重要，失去它让我感到难过而空虚。
例句：I'm sad that Julie's marriage is on the verge of splitting up.
我为朱莉的婚姻处于破裂的边缘感到难过。

violinist
音标：英 /,vaɪə'lɪnɪst/  美 /,vaɪə'lɪnɪst/
n. 小提琴演奏者, 小提琴家
例句：Rose's father was a talented violinist.
罗斯的父亲是一位天才的小提琴手。

cellist
音标：英 /'tʃelɪst/  美 /'tʃɛlɪst/
n. 大提琴演奏家
例句：A cellist is always shortening and lengthening the strings.
大提琴演奏家总是在压缩或拉长弦
例句：The music was also of the highest caliber, including tenor Placido Domingo and cellist Yo-Yo Ma.
音乐表演也是一流的，有男高音歌唱家多明戈和大提琴演奏家马友友。
例句：Performed consecutively and in order, as they were by the cellist David Finckel and the pianist Wu Han in Alice Tully Hall on Sunday evening, they provide a vivid snapshot of his artistic development.
上周日晚，在爱丽丝杜利音乐大厅，大提琴家大卫·芬科尔和钢琴家吴涵依次演奏了这五部作品，为听众清晰呈现了贝多芬音乐艺术的发展。

upsurge
音标：英 /'ʌpsɜːdʒ/  美 /'ʌpsɝdʒ/
n. 高潮 vi涌起
例句：A new upsurge in construction is in the making.
一个建设的新高潮正在兴起。

phenomenal
音标：英 /fɪ'nɒmɪn(ə)l/
adj. 现象的,显著的
例句：the phenomenal success of computer games in recent years
近年来电脑游戏的惊人成功

midocean
n. 海洋中央
例句：In fact, he wrote his dissertation on the midocean ridge.
实际上，他的博士论文就是关于中央山脊的研究。
例句：Because the tools and technology to locate those boxes in the depths of the midocean ridge were available for the first time.
因为深度可以到达中央山脊附近的技术和工具首次被使用。
例句：Airlines could also simply stream the data from select flights, like those crossing rough terrain — the Himalayas, for example, or the midocean ridge.
航空公司也会挑选一些航班，让它们在穿过像喜马拉雅山脉或者中央海脊这种复杂地形时传输数据。

deformation
音标：英 /,diːfɔː'meɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /'difɔr'meʃən/
n. 变形
短语：plastic deformation — [化]塑性变形，塑性应变
短语：elastic deformation — 弹性形变
短语：thermal deformation — 热变形；热形变
短语：shear deformation — 剪力变形；剪切形变
短语：deformation temperature — 变形温度
短语：finite deformation — 有限变形；有限形变
短语：deformation resistance — 抗变形性；变形阻力；耐变形性
短语：deformation rate — 变形率；应变率
短语：creep deformation — 蠕变
短语：crustal deformation — 地壳形变；地壳变形
短语：permanent deformation — 永久变形，残留变形

短语：compressive deformation — 压缩变形；压缩形变
短语：deformation energy — 变形能
短语：shearing deformation — 切形变；风切变形；剪切形变
短语：axial deformation — 轴变形；轴向形变，轴向变化
短语：resistance to deformation — 变形阻力；抗变形性
短语：deformation test — 变形试验
短语：residual deformation — 残余变形；残留变形
例句：B: It occurs when a component reaches its limit for deformation.
B：当一个部件达到了变形的极限时，就会发生断裂。
例句：This chapter presents guidelines relevant to finite element model construction and analysis methods for predicting the motion and deformation of optics and optical structures.
本章提供关于有限元模型建立、光学元件和光学结构的运动变形的预测分析方法方面的指导。
例句：The researchers found the pattern of surface deformation was dominated by movement on a previously unknown, subsurface thrust fault, named the Léogâne fault, which did not rupture the surface.
研究人员们发现，地表变形的纹路是被一个称做“里欧伽尼断层”的地下逆断层的运动所控制的。 而这个逆断层在之前一直未被发现。

omnibus
音标：英 /'ɒmnɪbəs/  美 /'ɑmnɪbəs/
n. 公共汽车, 精选集 a综合性的
例句：the Saturday omnibus edition of ‘Brookside’
《小溪边》的周六综合版

accessibility
音标：英 /ək,sesə'bɪlətɪ/  美 /æk,sɛsə'bɪləti/

unoccupied
音标：英 /ʌn'ɒkjʊpaɪd/  美 /,ʌn'ɑkjupaɪd/
adj. 空闲的,未占领的
例句：However, to do so, it must find an unoccupied territory and a member of the opposite sex with which to mate.
然而，要想成为领头狼，必须找到一块未被占领的领地和一头能够与之交配的异性狼。

catalyze

vacant
音标：英 /'veɪk(ə)nt/  美 /'vekənt/
adj. 空的, 头脑空虚的,空缺的
短语：vacant space — 空舱位；未用空间
短语：vacant room — 空房
短语：vacant position — 职位空缺；空座
短语：vacant land — 空地；闲置地
短语：vacant lot — 空地
短语：vacant seat — 空位，未被占座位
例句：Only a few apartments were still vacant.
只有几套公寓仍然空着。
例句：There was only a vacant lot (= empty unused area of land in a city ) where her house used to be.
她以前房子所在的地方只剩下一块空地了。

suite

n. (一批)随员, (一套)家具, 组
短语：a suite of — 一系列
短语：presidential suite — 总统套房；总统套间

例句：Pigs scavenged among the rubbish.

subdivision
音标：英 /'sʌbdɪvɪʒ(ə)n; sʌbdɪ'vɪʒ(ə)n/  美 /,sʌbdɪ'vɪʒn/

例句：Months are a conventional subdivision of the year.

juvenile

音标：英 /bɪ'treɪ/  美 /bɪ'tre/
v. 出卖, 背叛
短语：betray oneself — 原形毕露
例句：He felt that she had betrayed him.
他感觉她背叛了自己。
例句：She had betrayed her parents' trust .
她辜负了父母对她的信任。
例句：I would never betray a confidence (=  tell a secret that someone has trusted me with  ) .
我永远不会泄露秘密。

sensible
音标：英 /'sensɪb(ə)l/  美 /'sɛnsəbl/
adj. 有感觉的, 明智的
短语：sensible heat — 显热；焓
短语：sensible of — 察觉；了解
例句：She seems very sensible.
她好像很明智。
例句：sensible advice
合理的建议
例句：It’s sensible to keep a note of your passport number.
把你的护照号码记下来是明智的。
例句：Moving house seemed like the sensible thing to do .
搬家似乎是明智的做法。

treetop
音标：英 /'triːtɒp/  美 /'tri'tɑp/
n. 树稍
例句：Boardwalks on the forest floor and the treetop level let visitors experience the rain forest up close.
在树顶上搭建的森林地面走道可以让游客近距离地接触热带雨林。
例句：Keep kids and pets from knocking over the Christmas tree by securing it with clear fishing line attached to the treetop and a ceiling hook.
要阻止孩子和宠物撞到圣诞树通过用把钓鱼线树顶和天花板的钩链接起来。

ancestry
音标：英 /'ænsestrɪ/  美 /'ænsɛstri/
n. 祖先(集合称), 血统
例句：Most people of European or African ancestry have the "wet" kind: thick and sticky.
大多数欧洲或者非洲血统的人耳垢是湿的，厚的，有粘性的。
例句：Martin has shown that, of the eukaryotic genes whose ancestry can be traced, 75 per cent or more came from bacteria rather than the host cell.
马丁揭示，在哪些可以追溯到祖先的线粒体基因上，有75%或更多的成分来自当时外来的细菌而非宿主细胞。
例句：You can only explain this by evolutionary common ancestry.
你只能通过存在“进化上的共同祖先”来解释。

virginal
音标：英 /'vɜːdʒɪn(ə)l/  美 /'vɝdʒɪnl/
adj. 处女的, 无瑕的
例句：Somehow she'd always been a child in his mind, pure and virginal.
不知何故，她在他心里一直是个天真无邪的孩子。

dulcimer
音标：英 /'dʌlsɪmə/  美 /'dʌlsɪmɚ/
n. [乐] 洋琴
例句：The ancestry of the piano can be traced to the early keyboard instruments of the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries -- the spinet, the dulcimer, and the virginal.
钢琴的家系可以追溯至15至16世纪早期的键盘乐器，包括小型拨弦琴、洋琴和维金娜琴。
例句：That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up
你们一听见角，笛，琵琶，琴，瑟，笙，和各样乐器的声音，就当俯伏敬拜尼布甲尼撒王所立的金像。

unpublished

paddle
音标：英 /'pæd(ə)l/  美 /'pædl/

例句：We might be able to push ourselves across with the paddle.

例句：Ben’s words became jumbled.
本开始语无伦次起来。

音标：英 /bɪ'tjuːmɪnəs/  美 /bə'tʊmənəs/

短语：bituminous material — n. 沥青材料；沥青物料

practicable
音标：英 /'præktɪkəb(ə)l/  美 /'præktɪkəbl/

唯一可行的做法是把公司卖掉。
例句：It is their duty to ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that the equipment is safe.

acquaint
音标：英 /ə'kweɪnt/  美 /ə'kwent/
